row.body: A hammer and nails are wrapped in a note asking the next crew not to enter until the treated perimeter is dry. A neighbor’s name is replaced by “wait.”
row.title: Barricade by the quiet house

sidecar.gloss: A perimeter treatment delays a planned visit, leaving the contact unnamed.
sidecar.rival_reading: Containment staff could have treated a perimeter during cleanup; the note does not identify the material.
